question: Original text of the Indian Constitution contained ______ articles.
solution:
The correct answer is 395.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

__
 
• Indian Constitution was adopted by the Constituent Assembly of India on 26 November 1949 and became effective on 26 January 1950.
 
• There were 395 articles 8 schedules originally in the Constitution of India.
 
• Prem Behari Narain Raizada wrote the Indian Constitution by hand.
 
• Dr. BR Ambedkar is known as the father of the Indian Constitution.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information:__**

 
• The Indian Constitution was prepared in 2 years 11 months 18 days.
 
• It was decided to declare 26 November as Constitution Day.
 
• The National Flag of India was adopted on 22 July 1947.
 
• The ratio of the width of the flag to its length is 2 : 3.
 
• The National Flag has 24 spokes.
